bullets.text: a snail crossed the whole doorstep while i decided what to make for lunch. it won.
patching a bike tube at the kitchen table, glue everywhere, one thumb now stuck to the other.
duck reached jodo-ji. a seed sat on the temple step, planted by no one, already green in the crack. 🌿
settled. not happy exactly, just no argument with the afternoon.
the seed didn't ask whose field it was.
